```{r}

# Filter data

if(metaecosystem_analysis == TRUE) {
  
  filtered_data = ds_metaecosystems %>%
    filter(
      system_type %in% metaecosystem_type_input_analysis,
      time_point >= first_time_point_model,
      time_point <= last_time_point_model,
      !is.na(!!sym(response_variable))
    )
  
}

if(patch_analysis == TRUE) {
  
  filtered_data = ds_patches %>%
    filter(
      patch_type %in% patch_type_input_analysis,
      time_point >= first_time_point_model,
      time_point <= last_time_point_model,
      !is.na(!!sym(response_variable))
    )
  
}
```

```{r}

# Plot filtered data - points

if(metaecosystem_analysis == TRUE) {
  
  plot.metaecos.points(filtered_data,
                    metaecosystem_type_input_analysis,
                    response_variable,
                    legend_rows = 1)
  
}

if(patch_analysis == TRUE) {
  
  plot.patches.points(filtered_data,
                      patch_type_input_analysis,
                      response_variable)
  
}
```
